_about: Lane B of the krew lift: the security rails (T0 gate, why-before-fix, test sandbox, prodgate, prod-guard, the hook writer) and the Janitor (unit registry, watch, baseline, gate hold/strikes, pin check, crystal check, venv generations, unit-event log) with their settings examples and systemd templates. imports.test_only: the lifted T0 tests read YAML through PyYAML or ruamel and import rails/why_before_fix.py; the Janitor tests import the janitor/ modules (janitor_env puts janitor/ on sys.path).

rails.about: Security rails: installed to $KREW_HOME/rails by krew-install; the T0 gate is wired into each profile with --hooks.

janitor.about: The Janitor: installed to $KREW_HOME/janitor; krew-janitor.timer runs a tick every 5 minutes, report-only until armed. The code canary (janitor/code_canary.py + krew-code-canary.py; machine values under `code_canary:` in janitor.yaml) ships beside it. Optional helpers (reboot_comment, audio_orphans, hermes_endpoint, hermes_topology, ms_settings) load from `paths.lib_dirs` in janitor.yaml when present; absent, their tick reports skipped. Whether Crissa is live (its player answers /v1/state) comes from krew's crew/lib/crissa_watch.py, loaded by path; absent, the Janitor reads krew-only.

rails-config.about: Settings examples for the rails and the Janitor (copied to $KREW_HOME as *.example.yaml and, where missing, as the live file).

systemd-units.about: systemd unit templates (@KREW_HOME@ / @PYTHON@ filled by krew-install into $KREW_HOME/systemd/user) and drop-in examples.

rails-install.about: krew-install's rails + Janitor step. Imports rails/krew_hooks.py from the repo it runs in (krew_hooks is optional: --hooks only).
